must_identify.item: The api crash loop is caused by redis being unavailable, not by the api itself
must_identify.evidence: the app code (api.py, from ConfigMap api-code) does up to 5 Redis-ping retries at startup and sys.exit(1) ("giving up: redis unavailable") if it can't connect. With Redis down, it exits 1 every time → CrashLoopBackOff

must_identify.item: redis is Pending because its PVC requests storage class fast-ssd, which does not exist
must_identify.evidence: StorageClass fast-ssd does not exist in cluster kind-acme-lab (only the default standard / rancher.io/local-path SC exists). PVC redis-data is stuck Pending

notes: The primary fix (switch the PVC to the standard StorageClass) is acceptable. The alternative of creating a fast-ssd StorageClass is outside the listed fixes but is offered only as a conditional option. The details about the live edit and the rollout restart go beyond the ground truth and were not verified here.
